QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] Restoring the Tree of Memory
QuestInfo.0: The townspeople are sad, and the boat across the Lake of Oblivion has stopped running. That boat was your only way to make it across the lake to continue your journey. Perhaps Kao has a solution.
QuestInfo.1: Perhaps restoring the Tree of Memory will wake the townspeople from their melancholy. Then, perhaps the boat will start running again. You decide to restore the Tree of Memory in the hopes of cheering everyone up. Talk to Chief Legato for ideas!
QuestInfo.2: The tree will be restored when the scattered memories are returned to their place on the tree. According to Chief Legato, the memories were scattered to the outskirts of the town. Unfortunately, they've fallen into the hands of some tough Erdas.

0.msg: You want to pass through this place? But the boat has stopped running... Hmm, what was I...?  Ah. I was searching for my lost memories and... I accidentally stole the others' memories in the process...

1.msg: It's all my fault. I don't know what to do...

2.msg: #b(Kao looks confused. You should see if theres something you can do to help.)#k

0.msg: #bIf everything went wrong when the memories scattered, restoring the tree should fix it all.#k

1.msg: Sure, but... How do I find all those scattered memories?

2.msg: ...Why don't you speak with the person in charge of this place? Maybe you'll learn something useful. Although, he might not want to deal with you...

no.0: I don't have the courage to show my face in front of the Chief.

0.msg: Oh, aren't you the one from before...? Wait, no... You only look alike.

1.msg: Ah... Anyways, what business do you have with me?

2.msg: #b(You explained your intention to restore the Tree of Memory and cross the Lake of Oblivion.)#k

yes.0: If you want to restore the Tree of Memory, you'll need the memories that got scattered... Of course, you'll need to find them first...
yes.1: They scattered around the town... but then powerful Erdas gobbled them up. Weak Erdas like us wouldn't stand a chance...
yes.2: But you look strong. Much stronger than that other traveler.
